top.h: Govt absorbed ₹43 of ₹50 diesel hike: PM
top.intro: Prime Minister Narendra Modi told a farmers’ conference that the Centre absorbed ₹43 a litre of a possible ₹50 diesel increase during the West Asia conflict, so pump prices rose only ₹7. Crude jumped from $70 to $122 a barrel, costing ₹14,000 crore a month, he said.

bottom.h: Modified PSLV third stage clears ground test
bottom.intro: After two PSLV failures tied to the third stage, ISRO static-tested a reworked stage at Sriharikota with nozzle fixes and extra sealing. No return-to-flight date yet.

top.h: Europe to join next round of Ukraine peace talks
top.intro: Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoy Jared Kushner said European delegates will sit in on the next Russia–Ukraine talks, after US envoys met Vladimir Putin in Moscow and Zelensky in Dublin. The Kremlin has not confirmed Putin agreed.

bottom.h: Raigad’s Shrivardhan beach wins Blue Flag
bottom.intro: The Konkan beach in Raigad district has earned the international Blue Flag certification for clean water, safety and eco-friendly management.

lead.h: Exports Near $90 Billion; Goods Shipments Hit Record
lead.intro: NEW DELHI: India’s total exports of goods and services rose nearly 30% to $89.99 billion in October. Merchandise shipments alone touched a record $49.47 billion, despite the West Asia conflict.
lead.para: Imports grew even faster, lifting the goods trade deficit to a one-year high of $39.88 billion, but a strong services surplus narrowed the overall gap to $20.09 billion. The Sensex fell 319 points a day after retail inflation hit 6.09%, as traders priced in a possible RBI rate hike on 4 December.
glance: Goods exports at a record high

beside.h: Henry six-for, Young ton: NZ crush India by 244 runs
beside.intro: MOUNT MAUNGANUI: Will Young’s 125 off 108 balls lifted New Zealand to 333 at Bay Oval. Matt Henry then took six wickets as India’s chase collapsed early in the fourth ODI. India still lead the series 2-1, with one match left to play.

more.h: Guard agency loses licence after child murder
more.intro: Defensor Security lost its licence for hiring a guard without police checks; he allegedly killed a five-year-old for ransom.

second.h: Iran Says It Hit US Radar in Bahrain
second.intro: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said they targeted a US early-warning radar in Bahrain, home to the US Navy’s Fifth Fleet. They called it retaliation for a strike on a telecom tower in southern Iran.
second.para: Reuters called it Tehran’s first such claim in a Gulf country since early September. The IRGC Navy also said an LPG tanker blew up after hitting a sea mine in the Strait of Hormuz. Trump said Gulf allies had urged him to hold off big strikes, but he was not sure he agreed. Iran’s Speaker Ghalibaf said Tehran does not want the war to go on and the ‘ball is in America’s court’. For India, which ships much of its crude and LPG through the strait, Brent stays above $90.

singles.h: Visa forms shrink by up to 70%
singles.intro: Main visa types are cut from 13 to nine and forms lose 65–70% of their fields, with a new Visitor Visa from end-2026.
Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down worldwide on Thursday; about 1.3 lakh Outlook complaints were logged at peak.

singles.h: CAG audits 39 state discoms in one go
singles.intro: The CAG’s first integrated audit covers 39 state discoms for FY21–FY26, with a survey of 10,000 consumers.

singles.h: Murdoch-backed Bodhi Tree takes over A2B
singles.intro: Bodhi Tree, co-founded by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar, will invest $180 million for a majority stake in Adyar Ananda Bhavan.

row2b.h: Modi Flags Off Bengaluru–Madgaon Vande Bharat
row2b.intro: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is launching projects worth over ₹15,600 crore in Bengaluru today, led by a new 16-coach Vande Bharat linking Bengaluru, Mangaluru and Madgaon in Goa.
row2b.para: He will also open four redeveloped Amrit Bharat stations at Chamarajanagar, Chikkamagaluru, Sakleshpur and Subrahmanya Road. He will dedicate the 45-km Bagalkot–Wandal doubling, part of the 284-km Gadag–Hospet project, and the electrified 55-km Sakleshpur–Subrahmanya ghat section. The 16-coach train, with Executive and Chair Car coaches, will also serve Hassan, Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, Uttara Kannada and South Goa.

lighter.h: That Meow Is a Request: Cats Ask Humans for Help, Study Finds
lighter.intro: Your cat may be meowing on purpose. Researchers at the University of São Paulo put a favourite treat in a box that 38 pet cats could smell but not reach.
lighter.para: With an attentive person in the room, the cats meowed 86 times. Left alone, they meowed just 20 times, so a cat was more than 16 times likelier to call out when someone was watching. The study, in Animal Behaviour, calls it ‘recipient-specific signalling’. The authors caution it does not prove cats know we can help. Cat owners may disagree.
